THE PUBLIC DOMAIN SONG ANTHOLOGY | https://doi.org/10.32881/book2

direction-type.words: The spirituals in this anthology use lyrics from the earliest published versions available, which often reflect the work of early music researchers who collected them from the oral traditions. For more information on spirituals and performance practice, see the works by Abromeit and Jones in the Further Reading section.
